name: @workermill/agent
description: WorkerMill Remote Agent - Run AI workers locally with your own AI provider credentials

scripts.build:binary: tsc; node build.mjs && bun build --compile --target=bun-linux-x64 dist/entry.js --outfile dist/bin/workermill-agent-linux-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-x64 dist/entry.js --outfile dist/bin/workermill-agent-darwin-x64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-darwin-arm64 dist/entry.js --outfile dist/bin/workermill-agent-darwin-arm64 && bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 dist/entry.js --outfile dist/bin/workermill-agent-win-x64.exe
